flags.headline: Wildfire-liability-reform deadline (Aug 31) unresolved; CEO's credit-downgrade warning still live
flags.detail: EIX -1.64% today ($67.21). No new escalation since 8/6, but the underlying risk remains unresolved: CEO Pedro Pizarro has publicly warned that failure to pass a credit-supportive wildfire liability framework by the Aug 31 legislative deadline would likely trigger rating downgrades for SCE, pushing an already lowest-investment-grade rating into junk territory. No draft legislation has been reported as of this run. ~24 days remain to the deadline.
flags.thesis_link: Matches EIX key_risk: 'Elevated debt-to-equity of 216% amplifies financial risk from future wildfire events, adverse rate case outcomes, or rising interest rates -- despite mitigation investments, a single catastrophic fire in SCE's territory could create material liability.' A credit downgrade would directly worsen this exposure.

evidence.source: Yahoo Finance / Edison International CEO statement

flags.headline: Morgan Stanley cuts MARA to $5.50 PT, reiterates Underweight; insider Form 144 sale filed; -5.07% today, largest decliner in the book
flags.detail: MARA -5.07% ($10.68 vs $11.25 prior close), the largest single-day move in the portfolio today. Morgan Stanley reiterated Underweight and cut its price target to $5.50 from $7.00 on 8/6; a Form 144 filing signals an insider/affiliate intends to sell shares. Bitcoin itself was roughly flat-to-up overnight ($64,745, +$235), so this reads as an analyst-conviction and idiosyncratic move rather than a crypto-market-wide selloff. Q2 earnings due 2026-08-12.
flags.thesis_link: Matches MARA key_risk: 'Revenue concentration in Bitcoin mining means MARA's financial performance is essentially a leveraged derivative of Bitcoin price -- the company has no proven ability to generate profits independent of crypto market conditions.' An Underweight/PT-cut while BTC itself is flat is a sell-side signal on company-specific execution, not just crypto beta.
